notes.title: Crazy Critters - Combat Cats Is Now Entirely FREE TO PLAY!
notes.notes:
After careful consideration and thought I have decided to make Crazy Critters - Combat Cats a free to play title. The game will now be free for all to enjoy and keep.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/b12939cf0e039d18e0752132363a0b2de9770828.png[/img]

The game is a lot of fun and only had a small player base up until now and so I decided to make it free so as to allow everyone to join in the fun! I plan to add a sequel at some point in the future so this is a good way to get more players into the Crazy Critters universe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/09026530132e2747ea8ba7f64d970e885c7a02b6.png[/img]

I will incrementally update the game in the coming months as it finds a new player base that plays and enjoys it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/36e7ab7fcff6f25c4316a0931f7ff86314745c89.png[/img]

So, join in, and have some Crazy Critter fun!

notes.title: Patch Notes For 1 October 2024
notes.notes:
- Lowered player and bot jump height
- Balanced and lowered all audio volumes
- Updated to Unity 2022 from Unity 2019
- Updated main menu
- Made game free to play!

notes.title: New System! Emoticons!
notes.notes:
With this update I'd like to introduce a new system to the game, emoticons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/b8df2dc96302f0cb3cb9a19d9e2b03266571ee2e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/afa4fd99ce30b0be28d27afbb47a2e7bbec76b7f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/b8df2dc96302f0cb3cb9a19d9e2b03266571ee2e.png[/img]

This update is more of a cosmetic and communicative update rather than a game-play one. This system allows the communication between players by using only the emoticons that were added to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/b8df2dc96302f0cb3cb9a19d9e2b03266571ee2e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/1c483e42126b8f52747b44d5f276a0fe38e67ce6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/b8df2dc96302f0cb3cb9a19d9e2b03266571ee2e.png[/img]

This is a fun and easy way to respond when a great moment happens in-game like when you get a great kill or when someone kills you or just when you want to show a certain emotion during a game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/b8df2dc96302f0cb3cb9a19d9e2b03266571ee2e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/3ef1dff6573fc0f0d19914971e6b7317b24913ad.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/b8df2dc96302f0cb3cb9a19d9e2b03266571ee2e.png[/img]

Its easy and fun and simple to use!

notes.title: New Map! Stacked!
notes.notes:
With this update I'd like to introduce a new map to the game! Stacked!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/b8df2dc96302f0cb3cb9a19d9e2b03266571ee2e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/06ae552b50d023dfa54b19fef73449d80190d53b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/b8df2dc96302f0cb3cb9a19d9e2b03266571ee2e.png[/img]

Stacked is a simple and easy to navigate map where you play in an open ended storage area that has many crates and boxes stacked on each other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/b8df2dc96302f0cb3cb9a19d9e2b03266571ee2e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/e900823ece7d3e837c7ea19762603a3da9e918cb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/b8df2dc96302f0cb3cb9a19d9e2b03266571ee2e.png[/img]

This map is similar to the other maps but allows for a bit more open ended game play and gun play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/9f92be77e28d504c6aad9f11d6e45be0211356d9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673203/b8df2dc96302f0cb3cb9a19d9e2b03266571ee2e.png[/img]
